away.name: Sergei Bobrovsky
away.news: The Maple Leafs are riding a four-game winning streak while rotating goalies, and they'll continue the trend on Monday, with Bobrovsky tending the twine against the Calgary Flames. Bobrovsky hasn't been spectacular early in his Maple Leafs tenure and has been largely outplayed by counterpart Anthony Stolarz. The 38-year-old Bobrovsky has a 3.10 GAA and .895 SV% in eight games (3-3-2). The Maple Leafs enter Monday's action as -143 road favourites against a Flames team coming off a 4-1 win over the Detroit Red Wings, extending their winning streak to three games.

home.name: Devin Cooley
home.news: Cooley emerged as a 28-year-old rookie in the 2025-26 season, posting a 2.69 GAA and .909 SV% in 31 games (10-10-6) for a defensively porous Calgary Flames team. He hoped to carry that momentum into the 2026-27 season, but started on a sour note, allowing 10 goals on 55 shots (.818 SV%) in his first two games (0-2-0). That said, Cooley has rebounded, being nearly unbeatable, saving 100 of 104 shots (.962 SV%) in three games since (3-0-0). The Flames enter Monday's contest as +131 home underdogs against a Toronto Maple Leafs team that has scored 21 goals during a four-game winning streak.

away.name: Michal Postava
away.news: Postava has excelled at every level and will get his first chance to make an NHL impact on Monday. The 24-year-old Czech goalie posted a sublime 1.71 GAA and .937 SV% in 25 games (17-6-0) last season with the Grand Rapids Griffins (AHL), ultimately leading the organization to trade goalie Sebastian Cossa. That said, Postava will be put to the test in his first career start against the high-flying offence of the Edmonton Oilers. Detroit enters the action as +157 road underdogs.

home.name: Tristan Jarry
home.news: With Devon Levi (undisclosed) out week to week, the Oilers will continue to lean on Jarry. That said, Jarry's results haven't been encouraging, including Saturday's performance where he allowed six goals on 30 shots (.833 SV%) in a 7-2 loss to the Toronto Maple Leafs. The 31-year-old goalie has an ugly 3.73 GAA and .861 SV% in four games (2-1-1). Still, the Oilers enter Monday's contest as -175 home favourites against a Detroit Red Wings team coming off a 4-1 loss to the Calgary Flames.
